text.en:
//One For All?
//No wait, Reaper's Tithe. Yeah.

Dealing damage grants a stack of 'Blast Distributor' for 5 seconds, increasing your Grenade Stat by 10 per stack. Maximum of 5 stacks.

Kills grant ${10 * #d}% Grenade Ability Energy.

Using your Grenade Ability <title refills [G_refill] /> the Magazine with a 3 second cooldown.
